mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression through different mechanisms (benzodiazepine GABA agonism and antipsychotic dopamine antagonism), resulting in additive sedation and psychomotor impairment.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and impaired cognition; consider dose reduction of one or both agents if coadministration is necessary; counsel patient on avoiding other CNS depressants and activities requiring alertness.
